limitations: Ten distinct case names have passing observations; one actual UV return case fails. These are bounded local workflows, not a parity feature denominator.

The original helper rejected valid v/vt/vn, and one malformed setup used unsupported .obrush Append. Both original failures and exact source copies remain retained; corrected source-only tooling is separately hash-bound.
Normal OBJ import currently drops vt/original faces, returning a version2 plain2522V5040T project. This real consumer gate was not relaxed or rerun on unchanged binary.

Checked OBJ producer exports positions/normals/RGB/original triangle or quad faces/cornerUV exactly under explicit material-loss policy. PLY/STL omission reports and actual bytes are checked independently.
Shaders are an independent direct-light Studio/PBR/Normal implementation. Cropped pixel/actual-uniform response does not establish environment-map/texture/radiometric/reference visual parity.
Static original-face surfaces pause adaptive detail; explicit detach is undoable and retains materials. Draw samples are default positive short strokes only.
No material paint is included; that source is staged for a later frozen candidate. No SGL/texture/material-file exchange or native GUI/physical-tablet acceptance is established.
Release probes include asynchronous GPU readback; no latency/input-to-photon/performance claim.
Owned isolated CLI Chrome and localhost servers are cleaned up, all four owned PIDs confirmed gone. User tabs/profiles/native GUI/accessibility were not controlled.
Every actual served HTML/JS/WASM hash matches immutable candidate1; topology worker frozen but not requested.
